name: group
description: A group of the architecture model (#535): related elements bundled by what the code shows, so a large system or service can be drawn a level higher. Its key is its scope (a unit, or system), '/', its kind (feature-area or domain), '/' and its signal, such as service:io.acme:billing/feature-area/pkg-invoice: never its members, so adding one renames none.

name: group-of
description: The subject group's kind (#535): a feature-area, grouping a unit's components, or a domain, grouping the system's units.

scope.description: The unit whose components it groups, or system.

basis.description: The signal it rests on: a feature package, the resource segment of endpoint paths, a shared relational database, a gateway route prefix, a repository or a segment of the Maven groupId.

signal.description: The signal's value, as its key gives it: pkg-, path-, db-, route-, repo- or maven- and the package, segment, database key, repository or groupId segment.

facts.description: The facts behind the signal: those its members joined by.

name: GROUPS
description: The subject group holds the object element (#535). A kind of CONTAINS, a type of its own so derivation does not write what the extractors write.

basis.description: How it joined: by the group's signal, or, for a component no signal placed, by the calls between it and the group's components or the tables they share.
